title: FOCUS: First-Order Control Using Optimal Transport Supervision for Imitation from Observations
abstract: arXiv:2610.41540v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Imitation learning from observations must recover behavior from state-only demonstrations without known temporal correspondence. Differentiable simulators provide pathwise policy gradients, but differentiating through long, contact-rich trajectories can make optimization unstable. We introduce FOCUS, which combines local optimal-transport alignment with short-horizon differentiable actor-critic learning. FOCUS matches agent rollout windows to multiple sampled expert segments using a soft best-of-$K$ objective that emphasizes locally compatible matches. The resulting transport-based costs provide differentiable imitation rewards, while a learned critic bootstraps value beyond the rollout horizon. FOCUS requires neither temporally aligned trajectories nor expert-aligned initialization or teacher forcing. translated_title: FOCUS：基于最优传输监督的一阶控制用于从观察中模仿学习
translated_abstract: 从观察中进行模仿学习需要在没有已知时间对应关系的情况下，仅从状态演示中恢复行为。可微模拟器可以提供路径级策略梯度，但对长且富含接触的轨迹进行微分可能导致优化不稳定。我们提出了FOCUS，它将局部最优传输对齐与短时程可微的actor-critic学习相结合。FOCUS使用一种强调局部兼容匹配的软性best-of-$K$目标，将智能体的rollout窗口与多个采样的专家片段进行匹配。由此产生的基于最优传输的成本提供了可微的模仿奖励，同时学习到的critic可以在rollout时程之外自举价值估计。FOCUS既不需要时间对齐的轨迹，也不需要专家对齐的初始化或教师强制。在DFlex中的多种富含接触的运动控制任务上，包括一个由152个肌肉激活控制的肌肉骨骼人形机器人，FOCUS提升了……
tldr: FOCUS通过将局部最优传输对齐与短时程可微actor-critic学习相结合，在无需时间对齐轨迹、专家初始化或教师强制的条件下，实现了从仅含状态的演示中稳定高效地模仿学习。
en_tdlr: FOCUS combines local optimal-transport alignment with short-horizon differentiable actor-critic learning, enabling stable imitation from state-only demonstrations without requiring temporally aligned trajectories, expert-aligned initialization, or teacher forcing.
